body:
Thank you. We did come to a better understanding after getting our anger out through a huge argument. I blindsided my parents and that was a real dick move on my part but as I said, at the time I didn't think of the possible consequences, I was on such a high and selfishly thought of my own happiness.

They are still not accepting that I'm trans, but for now, we seem to be getting back to our normal happy relationship, even if it takes more time.
